name: Kerecseny (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a red triangle descending along the hoist edge and a green triangle along the fly edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kerecseny: a red shield with a yellow falcon and a white cross.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
